lines.en: My red scales scrape the stone

lines.zh: 我低飞时拖出一条长影
lines.en: I drag a long shadow when flying low

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有一道旧伤
lines.en: I carry an old scar on my wing
I walk along the base of the ruins' wall
One stride crosses a whole flagstone
My tail tip taps the stone
I leap from a broken pillar onto the roof

lines.zh: 我贴着断墙走，鳞片刮着石头
lines.en: I hug the broken wall, scales scraping stone
My claws dig into the brick seams

lines.zh: 我在遗迹外沿巡了一圈
lines.en: I make a circuit of the ruins' outer edge

lines.zh: 我的影子从头到尾盖过石板路
lines.en: My shadow covers the flagstone path end to end

lines.zh: 我落地时四爪分开撑住
lines.en: I land with all four claws braced apart

lines.zh: 我伏在遗迹最高的地方
lines.en: I crouch on the highest point of the ruins

lines.zh: 红色的翼在阳光下张开
lines.en: My red wings open in the sun
I listen for scents on the wind
My throat makes a low sound
I wait for anyone to dare come up

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直盯着入口
lines.en: My eyes stay fixed on the entrance
I rest my head on the stone rail

lines.zh: 尾巴垂在石阶上，一下一下敲
lines.en: My tail hangs off the step, tapping now and then

lines.zh: 我的鼻息把地上的沙吹开
lines.en: My breath blows the sand off the ground

lines.zh: 我的红鳞在阴影里更深
lines.en: My red scales are deeper in shadow
I fold my wings to my sides
I am watching that entrance

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在石壁间来回
lines.en: My breathing bounces between the stone walls

lines.zh: 我用爪子在石面上划了一道
lines.en: I score a line in the stone with a claw
Have you come to take dragon scales

lines.zh: 这具身体会掉鳞，但不会白给
lines.en: This body sheds scales, but not freely

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你的胆子
lines.en: Look up, let me see your nerve

lines.zh: 我的红色是这遗迹的记号
lines.en: My red is the mark of these ruins
I look up at you from the stone ledge

lines.zh: 你想打赢我，然后才能有蛋
lines.en: To get an egg you must beat me first
My bones are harder than my scales
You have no weapon, good
I let it lunge first

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看不上
lines.en: I have no use for what you carry

lines.zh: 门口就在那边，决定快点
lines.en: The door is right there, so decide fast
I never speak first
A scale was knocked off me

lines.zh: 爪子挠进鳞缝，我嘶了一声
lines.en: Claws dug between my scales, and I hissed
Blood is not obvious on red scales
My wings can still lift me

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩了一下地面
lines.en: My tail lashes the ground once

lines.zh: 这个气味，我刻进脑子里了
lines.en: That scent is carved into my skull
I cannot fold my wing back
My blood drips on the flagstone
This one will stay with me a long while
I lower my head, but I do not retreat

lines.zh: 你手上那点不合我的胃口
lines.en: That in your hand does not suit my appetite

lines.zh: 这遗迹里我什么都能找到
lines.en: I can find anything in these ruins
You are wasting strength holding it up
I dislike being fed
Put it down and step back three paces
This will not buy dragon scales
Put it away, the smell alone bores me

lines.zh: 你举多久，我都不会张嘴
lines.en: Wave it all day, my jaws stay shut

lines.zh: 这么点东西还想换什么
lines.en: What do you hope to buy with so little

lines.zh: 你收回去，我当你没举过
lines.en: Put it away and I will pretend you never raised it

lines.zh: 撞上来的力道，还不够掀我
lines.en: That impact is not enough to shift me
I did not move, you did

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，石头都在响
lines.en: We collided and the stones rang

lines.zh: 我的鳞片擦破了你的袖子
lines.en: My scales tore your sleeve
I turn my body aside to let you pass

lines.zh: 这一下让我看清了你的分量
lines.en: That let me weigh you
I pull my tail back

lines.zh: 我们撞得沙都跳起来了
lines.en: We collided and the sand jumped
My scale caught on your button
I back off and leave the way

lines.zh: 我这一窝蛋需要一个守着
lines.en: This clutch needs a keeper
Red scales belong with red
Why do you ask this
We do not mix with other kinds
I turn my head toward the nest

lines.zh: 我的时间都用在守蛋上
lines.en: All my time goes to guarding eggs

lines.zh: 我只需要一个窝和一段时间
lines.en: I need only a nest and some time
This needs no outsider's hand
I turn and walk back to the nest
I rest my claws on the nest's rim

lines.zh: 一爪勾起，甩到眼前看看
lines.en: One claw hooks it up for a closer look
This can line the nest
I carry it two steps
I glance at whatever falls
I press it into a stone crack
This piece is too soft
I toss it by the nest
I tuck it under the eggs
This can be bedding
I tear it in two with my teeth
Something living has come in
My wings open to their full span
These ruins tolerate no outsider
Wings tucked, I dive at you
My ears turn that way
I drop from the high ground
The stones block its sight
I will come down behind it

lines.zh: 我的紫火和红鳞一起亮
lines.en: My fire and red scales glow together

lines.zh: 这一片我闭着眼也认得
lines.en: I know this ground even blind
I will drive it out of the ruins

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面抓出印
lines.en: My claws gouge the ground
I begin my dive
There is no holding back in this strike

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一寸寸往前挪
lines.en: I flatten low and inch forward
It has backed to the wall
I keep the height and give no quarter

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出的热气烫着石板
lines.en: Hot breath from my nostrils scorches the flagstones
I wait for it to turn
I circle around past the pillar
It walks loudly on the flagstones
I drop my height to two blocks
My shadow reaches its feet first
Its back is turned to me
I wait for it to enter the narrow pass
Purple fire rolls in my throat

lines.zh: 它每退一步我就进两格
lines.en: For every step it retreats I take two
I half fold my wings

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在石面上轻轻扫
lines.en: My tail sweeps softly over the stone
I drop straight off the crossbeam

lines.zh: 我的爪子先落在它肩上
lines.en: My claws land on its shoulder first
My tail sweeps its legs out

lines.zh: 这一击带着整片遗迹的重量
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of the whole ruin
I bite and withdraw to the high ground
I strike its chest with one claw
My teeth bite into its shoulder plate
I knock it into a stone pillar
I sweep my tail across to trip it

lines.zh: 紫火从我的嘴里喷出去
lines.en: Purple fire bursts from my mouth
I pin it to the flagstones
I hold it down so it cannot rise
I bite and withdraw to the nest

lines.zh: 扑空一次，我翻身再压下来
lines.en: I miss once, then wheel and slam down again
I walk out of the depths of the ruins
My red scales dry one by one
Between these pillars, my word is law
I press my claws into the flagstone

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在入口扫了一下
lines.en: My tail sweeps across the entrance
I raise my head, the wind comes from there

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的裂缝里爬出来
lines.en: I crawl out of a crack in the ruins

lines.zh: 我的红鳞在入口处反光
lines.en: My red scales catch the light at the entrance
This body is my own
I am the keeper of these ruins

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一拍，沙全飞起来
lines.en: One wingbeat and the sand scatters

lines.zh: 砖缝里的沙被我一爪震起来
lines.en: Dust leaps from the cracks as I set down
First I must see who has come

lines.zh: 我把爪子在地上磨了磨
lines.en: I sharpen my claws on the ground
My old wound still aches
I raise my head and see you
Fire slides off my scales

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，砸碎了石板
lines.en: I fell from height and shattered the flagstone
Water seeped between my scales

lines.zh: 爆炸把遗迹的一面墙掀倒了
lines.en: The blast knocked down one wall of the ruins

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的肩甲缝里
lines.en: An arrow lodged in the gap of my shoulder plate
That magic passed through my scales

lines.zh: 守了太久，我也该吃点东西
lines.en: I have guarded too long, I should eat something
Lightning struck my spine

lines.zh: 遗迹下面什么都没有了
lines.en: There is nothing under the ruins
